svg.text: Columns = home gene order · Rows = species (phylogenetic order) · arrow points in coding strand
GOI gene model: exons (CDS) to scale, ∧ = intron (not to scale), genomic orientation; one scale for the whole column
thin = aligned hit segments, no gene model
number = % identity · (n) = % coverage when < 80% · shade = % identity · GOI ×N = N models in the neighbourhood, best one drawn (all in the synteny plot)
an empty cell means no ortholog was PLACED in this neighbourhood, not that the gene is absent · strong hits refused on synteny are listed in synvoy_report.json → rejected_candidates
